crossRefs.note: Now these things, brothers, I have in a figure transferred to myself and Apollos for your sakes, that in us you might…
But if anyone thinks that he knows anything, he doesn’t yet know as he ought to know.
Pride goes before destruction, and an arrogant spirit before a fall.
Blessed is the man who always fears; but one who hardens his heart falls into trouble.
But Peter answered him, “Even if all will be made to stumble because of you, I will never be made to stumble.”
Jesus said to him, “Most certainly I tell you that tonight, before the rooster crows, you will deny me three times.”
He came to the disciples, and found them sleeping, and said to Peter, “What, couldn’t you watch with me for one hour?
Watch and pray, that you don’t enter into temptation. The spirit indeed is willing, but the flesh is weak.”
True; by their unbelief they were broken off, and you stand by your faith. Don’t be conceited, but fear;
Because you say, ‘I am rich, and have gotten riches, and have need of nothing;’ and don’t know that you are the…
I counsel you to buy from me gold refined by fire, that you may become rich; and white garments, that you may clothe…

translations.web: Therefore let him who thinks he stands be careful that he doesn’t fall.
translations.bsb: So the one who thinks he is standing firm should be careful not to fall.
translations.kjv: Wherefore let ➔ him that thinketh he standeth take heed lest he fall.
translations.asv: Wherefore let him that thinketh he standeth take heed lest he fall.
